cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Adaptive Socratic tutoring for secondary-school mathematics and scientific reasoning, designed for offline classroom use on a shared 8 GB laptop.

test_prompts.prompt: A trader buys 24 identical crates for 18000 naira and sells them at a 25% profit. What is the selling price of one crate? Show your working.
A student says that if a number is divisible by 4 it must also be divisible by 8. Guide them to discover why this is false, without stating the counterexample yourself.
